name: Starship Breakers: Alpha
source:
Patricia stopped taking part in climbing activities after getting injured at a local tournament. She’s now studying in Iceland and needs money. One day, she finds a shady gig about playtesting an action escape game and finds herself trapped in a fictional spaceship. She must escape using both her wits and her agility.


[From [url=https://komehara.itch.io/starship-breakers-alpha]itch.io[/url]]
